answer: Give each identity its own private apprenticeship: over months it alone receives a unique sequence of mentors, tasks and failures, and that lived history becomes its anchor. Later, a live test asks it to combine several of those past lessons at once, like facets meeting in one crystal. A sybil operator sharing one mind either leaks identical experience traces across clones, which auditors can spot, or must fund a genuinely separate learning life per identity — years of distinct effort that cannot be copied like ivory carvings from a single mould.
